lessons.lesson: When PO number, amount, and date all match, approve the invoice even if the vendor name is not yet in the master; flag for vendor master enrichment rather than escalating (POL-00x).
Duplicate detection must use PO number + amount + date proximity as matching criteria regardless of vendor master status; missing vendor records do not prevent duplicate identification (POL-00x).
Escalate only when critical fields (PO match, amount, or date) are ambiguous or missing; a known PO with matching details should never escalate solely due to an unknown vendor (POL-00x).

Apply case-insensitive, punctuation-tolerant vendor name matching before escalating for 'vendor not found'; unresolved name variants that match an existing PO should be flagged for master cleanup, not escalated (POL-00x).
